in_marathi.name: Chittu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Intelligence, Knowledge, Wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chittu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chittu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'chitra' which means intelligence or skill. It is a name of the Hindu god Ganesha, who is the god of wisdom and knowledge. Chittu is a name of wisdom, intelligence, and knowledge.
